overview.text: Laevitas API V2 presents cryptocurrency derivatives data through REST, WebSocket and MCP. Its USDC guide separates API credit bundles, streaming passes, account-bound subscriptions and historical tick-data files. The $0.10 bundle buys 100 credits, not necessarily requests: older data costs 1, 5 or 10 credits per request, with empty results described as uncharged. Broader 100-call language is qualified by those rules and the final quote. Credit tokens expire after 24 hours but wallet-attached credits can be accessed through token refresh without repurchase. Streaming costs $0.50/hour or $10/day. Prepaid Premium/Enterprise list 50/500 USDC monthly without automatic wallet renewal; Premium lacks Enterprise API rights. Tick-data quotes depend on files, dates and coverage gaps, with orders owned by the signed-in account. Paid confirmation is not file preparation or delivery. Accountless API credit access does not generalize to subscriptions/exports, and prices, coverage and performance are publisher descriptions rather than tested guarantees.
